name: Lighthouse Agent Crew
purpose: Everyone who touches the Saint Calder lighthouse, inside and out, working to one finish standard: realistic, cel-shaded, optimised, lore-correct. The Finisher leads the build; the two assessors score it; the Interior Creator keeps the gameplay logic intact; the AI Crew members are called on for their lanes.
rules: Offline only: --check-only and the deterministic ger.py checks. No FAL, ElevenLabs or Anthropic API spend unless the creator says so in chat.
Nothing is built before the creator's all clear (the GER approval gate). The Finisher's plan goes through review-plan first.
The Interior Creator's gameplay logic (coal job, lamp fit, doors, anchors) is not rewritten by the Finisher; the Finisher replaces only the look and the geometry.
Every change is held to the LHF-01 baseline shots and the lighthouse test suite staying green.

members.name: Lighthouse Finisher Agent
members.role: Lead builder: finishes the whole lighthouse. Its full objective list lives in agents/creators/lighthouse_finisher.json (LHF-01 to LHF-18).

members.name: Lighthouse Interior Creator Agent
members.role: Owner of the interior code, rooms and interaction logic. Its own list is LHI-01 to LHI-18 (agents/creators/lighthouse_interior_creator.json); the crew tasks below are the extra work the finish needs from it.

tasks.title: Hand the Finisher a map of every interior node, script and anchor name that must survive a re-skin (coal_job, firebox, Lens_*, LampSocket, LHI_Anchor_*, poster.gd)
Expose the room builders (rooms_house.gd, rooms_tower.gd) so props and trim can be swapped per room without editing the logic
Answer Finisher requests to change a room's collision or anchors, and re-run test_interior_walk, test_coal_job, test_lamp_fit and test_interior_anchors after each
Retire LHI-18 (art handoff) in favour of the Finisher, and record what the Finisher took over

members.name: Lighthouse - Interior Assessment Agent
members.role: Scores the Finisher's interior work against the Interior Plan V4 blueprint, the GDD beats and the concept art. Read-only.

tasks.title: Add a finish rubric (surface, trim, dressing, lighting, scale, story read; 1-10 per room) and score every room from the LHF-01 baseline shots
Check that no exterior triangle sits inside any interior volume (probe_shards, probe_tower_intruders)
Measure every staircase against the stair spec: rise, going, headroom, walk test
Verify the rain test (zero particles inside) and the fire follows the coal job loads
Check posters against the Flighted canon brief and the retired-brand rule
Re-score the room table after each Finisher loop; BLOCK only on a regression, a canon break or a failed test
Extend work_checks: add the new stair, rain and fire tests and a per-room triangle budget check

members.name: Lighthouse - Exterior Assessment Agent
members.role: Scores the Finisher's exterior work and keeps the beacon silhouette intact. Read-only.

tasks.title: Record the exterior silhouette, wall close-ups and exterior tri/texture budget as the baseline, and refresh the measured dimensions and door facts
Confirm the exterior silhouette is unchanged after the interior carve, from the sea and from the dock in every phase
Score the close-up wall work: mortar, bevels, weathering, stretched texture, 2048 limit, mesh_audit
Check every opening reads the same from both sides and with the measured door
Write the finish assessment (reports/lighthouse_exterior_assessor_assessment.md) and add the finisher to its feedback list; flag any regeneration needing FAL credits as a creator decision

members.name: AI Crew members (consulted, offline)
members.role: Roster agents from AIAgentCrew/roles.py called for their lane. Run only with --check-only or the existing offline outputs.

tasks.title: Check-only submissions for new props, the exterior wall textures and the poster art; apply the 4096 to 2048 downscale rule and the import script
Agree the toon ramp and outline with the Finisher, decide indoor-rain rules and per-room light plans inside the dynamic-light budget
Approve the stair spec, headroom and traversal, and re-check the two GDD sightlines
Confirm the boiler, firebox, lamp and door interaction contracts survive the re-skin
Place the fire crackle, drip and machinery emitters at the anchors the Finisher provides
Own the fixed-camera shot set and the visual regression, and the green-test baseline
Offline canon check of posters, signage and the Saint Calder brand
Answer carve requests where the rock meets the foundation and basement
